scope: P05 manual create on DEV/TEST; production activation remains OFF

numbering.allowed: Actual active scoped grants and schema readiness, not the root legacy role-derived permissions flag

save_headers: If-Match: quoted draft version, 0 for first SAVE
transport.rule: Keep original key/body/version/session/warehouse and tracked shift request identity. This header does not replace P03 or P14 identity/preconditions.

save_request.partial_form: Recipient/address/quantity/scan rows may be incomplete at SAVE. codes=[] and absent/null title are accepted. Existing P03 JSON limits, secret rejection and unknown top-level field rejection remain unchanged.
save_request.form: Untrusted UI snapshot, never executed as a business request. Preserve nested JSON object/array shapes. form.p05_create may retain the App snapshot; structured address dataset names do not become BE-validated address codes.
save_request.forbidden: No client doc_no/document_no/actor/session/version override; numbered create mode rejects source_document_id/source_version/source_id or p05_source linkage.
save_request.source_kind: Personal staging draft only. A canonical Web document ID must not be reused as the numbered draft ID.

save_response.receipt: data.receipt is the existing P03 durable receipt; original numbered response is persisted in the same transaction.
save_response.read_detail: data.document_no; list uses data[].document_no; reconcile current document uses data.document.document_no.
save_response.no_name_substitute: A number is not a fabricated title/name/note/recipient. The existing optional name semantics remain unchanged.

persistence.ownership: outbound_draft_numbers.draft_id FK -> mini_app_drafts.document_id -> exact actor/auth_session/warehouse/scan identity. One unique doc_no per unique draft.
persistence.counter: Global receipt-independent PX sequence per Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh assignment date, minimum four digits. Lock the date row and include both existing stock_documents.doc_no and retained reservations; never COUNT+1.
persistence.later_save: New key/current version on the same draft preserves its number, even across Vietnam midnight. Changes to address or other UI metadata never regenerate it.
persistence.cancel: Retain the reservation and counter permanently; do not recycle the number.
persistence.atomicity: Draft, receipt, counter and reservation commit together or roll back together.
persistence.legacy: No migration backfill and no allocation on GET/replay. A legacy SAVE receipt with no number stays unnumbered. To assign one, perform an explicit new authorized SAVE with a new intent key and current known version after resolving UNKNOWN.

record.validation: Existing p05-outbound-record-field-matrix-v1 and N/N/identity/availability/source checksum/transaction rules remain authoritative. SAVE success is not RECORD readiness.
record.number_mapping: The owned reservation is passed internally to the existing canonical creator; data.doc_no equals the SAVE number. Draft UUID, business UUID and source import/request IDs remain distinct.
record.receipt: Existing P03 handoff/RECORD receipt and original-key replay remain unchanged. The reservation is enforced even if the numbering header is omitted on a later call with the same draft.
record.source_linked: The old selected-Web-source mode uses its original doc_no and P05 source/version guards. A numbered manual draft cannot switch to source-linked RECORD.
record.precondition: Sending the numbering header without original P03 draft identity is rejected. A draft not explicitly numbered cannot be recorded under the new opt-in contract.

authorization.canonical_authority: Existing effective ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN assignment as recognized by P03; not an arbitrary role display label. See the current authorization-policy contract.
authorization.save_record: For ordinary roles: actual ACTIVE outbound.scan AND (outbound.request.manual_create OR outbound.import) grants scoped to the confirmed warehouse.
authorization.read: Canonical authority or actual ACTIVE outbound.view grant.
authorization.cancel: Canonical authority or actual ACTIVE outbound.cancel grant, plus confirmed latest SAVE receipt/version.
authorization.grant_source: Effective ACTIVE roles scoped to the warehouse (or genuine unscoped role grants), ACTIVE permissions and direct ACTIVE user grants; canonical SUPER_ADMIN policy is shared with the existing P03 owner. Role display labels alone never grant access.
authorization.scope: Existing P03 active account, stable authenticated family, confirmed warehouse context and warehouse ACL remain required.
authorization.revocation: Existing numbered objects recheck actual grants even when a caller drops the opt-in header; no ownership takeover or new login to bypass the original context.

unknown_and_replay.original_receipt: Same key/body/version/context returns the original response and number. Current document and historical receipt response are separate.
unknown_and_replay.unknown: GET the original operation key only; opt-in reconcile returns retry=CHECK_ONLY, new_document_allowed=false. Absence is not failure or permission to allocate another draft/number.
unknown_and_replay.tracked_shift: P14 may return OWNER_RECONCILE_REQUIRED instead of replaying a SAVE mutation. Use the original-key GET. Do not change request identity or disable the shift fence.
unknown_and_replay.conflicts: Existing version/scan-session/body/key mismatches remain errors, never a replacement draft/number.

release.migration_scope: Only two additive empty reservation/counter tables. No product/stock/document repair, history backfill, role grant or seed.
release.deploy: Stage and verify the exact candidate preserving P18, assets, dependencies, environment, flags, storage and nginx configuration. Run only the named migration path; do not execute pending P11 or unrestricted migrate.
release.rollback: Retain tables/counters. Old code is reservation-unaware: automatic code rollback is allowed only before any PX reservation has been issued; otherwise require a reservation-aware forward fix.
release.app_acceptance: Source tests, migration and health do not imply authenticated live write/App UAT PASS. Live SAVE/RECORD needs a separately permitted TEST owner/identity, never real stock posting to obtain evidence.
